sections.h2: A painting contractor that works the southeast corner of Alachua County
body: Hawthorne sits on the southeast side of Alachua County, where lake country and highway frontage share the same zip code. Working as painters in Hawthorne, FL means dealing with two distinct housing stocks: weathered lakeside homes with decades of paint on them, and recent houses built along the SR-20 corridor. They fail in different ways, so we do not price or prep them the same way.

Our company is owned locally and run out of Newberry, a short trip west, and our painters have more than 15 years in the trade. Florida license, bond, full insurance, and workers' comp for each employee are all in place, and no Hawthorne job is ever passed to an outside sub. Whoever takes the tape measure to your walls also picks up a brush on them.

sections.h2: Two housing eras, two prep plans
body: Around Lochloosa, Johnson Lake, and Little Orange Creek, many homes have decades of paint history on them. Wood trim has been recoated more times than anyone remembers, window sills hold soft spots, and the bottom edge of fascia is usually the first thing to go. On these homes the bulk of the labor is scraping back to a sound edge, cutting out rot, re-caulking open joints, and spot-priming bare wood before a single topcoat goes on.

Newer homes along SR-20 and around Downtown Hawthorne tend to have the opposite problem: the substrate is fine, but the original builder coat is thin. Flat interior walls scuff the first time someone moves a couch, and exterior color starts to chalk early. Those jobs lean on a deep cleaning, bonding primer on any slick spots, and then two full coats of a premium acrylic thick enough to protect what the builder skimped on.

sections.h2: What lake air and summer storms do to a paint job here
body: Lake air keeps Hawthorne sticky all summer, with humidity sitting above 75 percent for months, and between June and September a thunderstorm shows up most afternoons. Walls that sit in the shade of oaks or face the lake stay damp long enough to grow mildew, while south- and west-facing walls lose pigment to UV. A good plan treats those elevations differently, so our estimates note moisture readings and sun exposure side by side.

Big outdoor projects here get booked for the October-to-May stretch whenever the homeowner can wait. If it has to be summer, the crew is on site by early morning, and nobody opens a gallon until the lead has checked the dew point and the radar. Inside jobs fit any month.

sections.h2: Services we bring to Hawthorne properties
body: Most calls start with one surface and grow from there. Homeowners often begin with repainting the outside of the house, usually after soft washing the mildewed siding, then add a deck re-stain or fence painting and staining. Inside, we handle walls, ceilings, and trim, tired oak kitchens through cabinet refinishing in Hawthorne, and palette decisions through a local color consultation. Shop owners along SR-20 can read about commercial repaints scheduled around business hours. Homeowners planning both halves of the house should see residential painting for Hawthorne homes, and the full Hawthorne service overview lists everything else.

sections.h2: How a Hawthorne project moves from walkthrough to punch list
body: Call us, and a crew lead is usually standing in your Hawthorne yard within 48 hours, measuring walls, photographing problem spots, and metering any wood that seems damp. Roughly a business day later you get the itemized quote: covered and excluded surfaces, the prep list, primer and finish products by line, coat counts, and dates. Additions only happen with your signature.

Your start date generally falls one to three weeks past approval. On a lakeside Hawthorne home, the first stretch is prep, and plenty of it: rinsing off the green film, scraping and sanding generations of old coats, replacing punky fascia, sealing seams, and priming any wood left bare. Finish coats follow, and the job ends with you and the crew lead inspecting everything; flagged items are corrected before you sign, and labelled leftover paint stays at the house.
Hawthorne is one stop on a regular route through Alachua County. We also paint in Micanopy, Gainesville, and our home base of Newberry, so scheduling a walkthrough out your way is rarely a problem.

faqs.q: Do you paint older homes near Lochloosa and Orange Lake?
faqs.a: Yes. Those homes are a large share of our Hawthorne work. Expect more prep time for scraping, rot repair, and spot-priming than a newer house would need, and expect all of it to be listed on the estimate.

faqs.q: How soon can you walk a property in Hawthorne?
faqs.a: Most Hawthorne visits happen inside 48 hours of the first call, with the written price arriving about a business day later.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured for work in Hawthorne?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Florida license, bond, insurance, and workers' comp coverage for each painter are current. Hawthorne shops and HOAs that need the paperwork receive a COI with their entity named on it ahead of the first work day.

faqs.q: Do I have to leave the house while you paint inside?
faqs.a: No. The painters shift and cover your furniture and keep the work confined to a single room at a time, so daily life in the house carries on.
